title: Lean verification campaign for Tate degree-sixteen cohomology in genus at most seven
exact_theorem: For every stable pair (g,n) with g at most 7, the degree-sixteen rational cohomology of the complex Deligne-Mumford stack Mbar_{g,n} of stable genus-g curves with n ordered markings is a finite direct sum of Q(-8), with rank zero allowed. Equivalently H^{16}(Mbar_{g,n};Q) is isomorphic to Q(-8)^{oplus b_{g,n}} as a polarizable rational Hodge structure. No Betti-number formula, algebraic or tautological generation, integral statement, or coarse-moduli statement is asserted.
lean_target_contract: The exported theorem must quantify over every StablePairIndex p satisfying 3 <= 2*g+n and g <= 7, and conclude the whole-group compact cohomology predicate at stable compactified complex DM stack geometry, rational coefficients, ordered markings, cohomological degree 16, weight 16 and Tate index -8. Rank is finite but unspecified and may be zero. Selected examples, an open or coarse space, an image, quotient, associated graded, semisimplification, algebraic-generation claim, or differently indexed group does not satisfy this contract.

obligations.statement: Represent the repaired M_{5,8} input, not Liu's unrepaired Corollary 3.9: the CKgP, tautological Chow, cohomological Ionel vanishing, and exact open BM conversion must be available as distinct premises.
Represent the five critical endpoint vanishings with strict vcd inequalities, inclusive marking endpoints, and the Ionel-Looijenga source vanishing; do not use at-vcd vanishing.
Represent the complete open Borel-Moore result for every stable pair with 3<=g<=7, including the stronger zero range 2g+n>=11 and the remaining published-range Tate cases.
Represent the genus 0,1,2 degree-sixteen base cases, odd compact vanishing through degree nine, and even compact Tate type through degree fourteen as separate audited inputs.
Type one-edge boundary factors separately from their parent and prove stability, non-increasing genus, and strict decrease of the induction complexity.
Represent the boundary Kunneth assembly, odd-odd disposal, positive even-even Tate typing, finite graph invariants, and passage from the normalized boundary source to its homological image.
Represent the degree-preserving, untwisted right-exact boundary sequence with distinct boundary-image, compact-homology, and open-BM carriers and the correct kernel/quotient orientation.
Represent smooth-proper purity, same-weight semisimplicity, and proper same-degree H_16/H^16 duality with Q(8) dual to Q(-8), never the open dimension-dependent Poincare twist.
Carry out genuine well-founded strong induction for every stable pair with g<=7; no finite list of examples or same-complexity recursive premise is acceptable.
